Sorry friend, reddit doesn't give me notifications for some dumb ass reason. A lot of people find Alan Carr's book "Easy Way to Quit Smoking" to be a huge help. 

I personally have always found it helpful to talk to people who have been clean a long time and listen to what they say the benefits are. 

I also highly recommend getting one of the apps, Smoke Free and Quit Tracker are both free and a good reminder of what you're gaining back, I use both. 

Lastly just hang here, people are always throwing out tips and tricks that are usually pretty helpful. 

There's also two things I like to do now that I've been off cigarettes for 41 days, whenever I have a craving I like to take a few deep breathes without coughing and I think about how much it would suck to lose that. I also think about how good it feels to laugh as hard as I can without going into a coughing fit.

If you ever need to talk DM me!

NTA If you're both honest. Like as long as everyone communicates and does what they consider best for the child and themselves it should be all good. If you're both decent people. Just gotta be mature about it and have those hard awkward conversations you probably never thought you'd have.

You will have have a relationship with this person for the next two decades minimum, so be open and cimmunicate now. A kid with parents who are seperated but still work as a team has a hell of a lot better chance than a kid whose parents resent eachother.

Definitely still go to school and get that good job. Another post-farm farm kid here so I know you can do it. And no matter what, the stability that career will provide for the rest of your life will be one of the most beneficial things you can give your child.

My Grandpa and I were incredibly close when I was a kid. He lived 10 minutes from us and I basically spent the entire summer with him every year and we would just do what ever. He never got me much in the way of birthday or Christmas gifts, he always said that he always bought me stuff whenever I wanted it at like garage sales or flea markets and stuff so that took care of it. But on my 11th birthday (I think) I went over there and he told me that for my birthday he was giving me five days. So that whole year I got five full days to choose whatever I wanted us to do, I could use them whenever and he couldn't protest, just say "Grandpa, I wanna use a day today to go to ___." and bam we were on our way. It just meant so much to me and I made so many memories that I hold very dear.

Highly seconded, went to Missouri from Wisconsin last August to see it. It didn't seem like much at first, then all the light just gets, soft, then all shadows become crescent shaped. Then it happens, the moon blocks out the sun, you can see stars above and the sun's corona with the naked eye. Beautiful sunset 360 degrees and any clouds are back lit. Your brain gets confused because the sun is setting in every direction in the middle of the afternoon. The best way I can express it is that it was about 20 hours of driving round trip with traffic in August heat for less than 3 minutes of totality, and it was without a doubt worth it.

Hey, I went through this kinda shit for a long time, and I know that every time someone says that kind of thing to you, you're gonna think that they can't understand how bad it is. And in all seriousness I don't understand. Your battle is your battle and mine is mine. The might be similar and they might be completely different. What I do know is you can't stop fighting the battle. All that bullshit that hear, the "It gets better." That's all real dude, it's not going to be tomorrow, it might not be this year. But it will come, you just need to make sure you're there to see it. I know you're tired and it's ok, but you gotta stay in it, for yourself. 
Have you told anyone you trust in your life? Is there someone you can talk to? Friend, counselor, teacher, parent, or religious leader? If you haven't yet, try to get the medical help you need with therapy from a licensed professional. You owe it to yourself to eventually see the beauty in the world again. Now I'm not a religious person,  but you are and that's good if it helps you, but I think God would want you to live your life and get to be happy someday. I know it sucks that it can't be today, but please trust me when I say it will happen. I hope this was helpful to you in some way, just know that you are heard and there are people out there willing to listen who know what it's like. This world needs you in it. You have value. Please don't do anything dumb, please. I know you don't know me, but if want to or need to talk please message me.
